Self.Wiki: Fast travel override (the game's CSFastTravelOverrideRegionIns). While the player is inside it, its flag replaces the Enable Fast Travel Event Flag ID of the collision underfoot and of MapDefaultInfoParam, so fast travel works only while that flag is ON. No retail Nightreign map uses it; the game reads the flag like Elden Ring does.

EnableFastTravelEventFlagID.AltName: Enable Fast Travel Event Flag ID
EnableFastTravelEventFlagID.Wiki: Fast travel is allowed inside this region only while this event flag is ON. 0: no override (the collision's or map's flag applies).
